messages.body:
Morgan — here's the BigCorp update cleared by Dani:

**Root cause identified:** The Friday hotfix deployed without the workspace_id index fix, causing the events endpoint to choke under BigCorp's ETL load.

**What to tell Casey:** Root cause identified, fix in progress, estimated resolution same business day pending final validation. Do NOT give a hard clock time — "same business day" is the commitment.

Kai is running the schema migration now (~30-60 min) and will validate before deploying the patch. I'll notify you immediately if anything changes. Please hold any external comms to BigCorp until I give you the all-clear.

Morgan — Dani has signed off on the BigCorp message. Please send Casey the following:

"Root cause identified: the Friday hotfix was deployed without a required database index fix, which caused the events endpoint to degrade under BigCorp's ETL load. Fix is in progress (schema migration, estimated 30–60 min to run + validate). Resolution expected same business day pending final validation. We'll update you as soon as it's confirmed complete."

**Do NOT give a hard clock time** — "same business day" is the commitment Dani approved. Let me know once you've sent it to Casey.
Done — just sent Casey the approved message. I'll hold any further comms until you give the all-clear on resolution.

Morgan — update on BigCorp: Kai just called a no-go. The shard boundary off-by-one wasn't resolved in time, so we're rolling back the BigCorp shard now. Rollback should complete before t=3060. No data loss — it's a counting artifact, not corruption. I'll give you the all-clear once Kai confirms rollback complete. Hold any customer-facing comms to BigCorp until then.

Understood — holding all comms to Casey until you give the all-clear post-rollback. I need to know ASAP once Kai confirms it's done so I can get ahead of this with BigCorp before end of business. Three deals are riding on this account.

Morgan — Kai confirmed the BigCorp shard rollback is complete (t=2942 call-it-no-go, rollback executed). You're clear to reach out to Casey/BigCorp now. Rollback was clean — no data loss, the shard boundary anomaly was a counting artifact, not corruption. Let me know if you need anything else to manage the account.

Done — just sent Casey the rollback update. Kept it factual: clean rollback, no data loss, counting artifact, permanent fix in progress. I'll manage the account from here and loop you in if anything escalates.

Morgan — following up on the BigCorp rollback. Kai confirmed rollback complete with no data loss (the anomaly was a counting artifact in shard boundary logic, not corruption). Kai is now working on the permanent fix. 

For the audit-log / AUDIT-5: Priya has confirmed she's on track for t=4320 with ISO-8601 UTC as the API contract. I'll flag immediately if anything threatens that deadline given your three deals riding on it.

On task.OPS-5 (confirm audit-log capability commitment with sales) — can you give me a quick summary of what you need to commit to customers? I want to make sure we're aligned before you make any external promises.

Morgan — confirmed from Kai: the BigCorp shard rollback is complete, no data loss, the anomaly was a counting artifact in the shard boundary logic (not corruption). Sounds like you've already sent Casey the update — great, that's exactly the right message.

On audit-log: AUDIT-5 (API contract for partners) is In Progress with Priya, due t=4320. I'll flag you immediately if anything looks like it might slip past that deadline.

Morgan — update on BigCorp: Kai has called a no-go on the migration. The BigCorp shard is being rolled back now (Kai confirmed rollback should complete well before t=3060). No data loss — the anomaly was an off-by-one in shard boundary logic, not corruption.

Per Dani's guidance, we're not committed to a hard clock time — "same business day" stands. Once Kai confirms rollback complete, I'll give you the all-clear to communicate to BigCorp. Sit tight for now.
